mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.0% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% (3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points over three months indicates labor market deterioration, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises by >0.2pp over prior 3 months (3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and payrolls (PAYEMS) signals robust consumer and business demand, driving corporate earnings expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and PAYEMS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases (3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 indicates supply constraints that amplify inflationary pressures and reduce corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is below 110.0 (3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS) above its 200-day moving average directly supports consumer-driven corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS exceeds its 200-day moving average (3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.0% signals persistent price pressures that trigger aggressive monetary tightening expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0 (3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rise in unemployment (UNRATE) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates severe economic contraction, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling INDPRO fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases (3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5.0% indicates active monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0% (3-year rolling window).
